title: DavidHDev/canvas-ui
claim: DavidHDev/canvas-ui — A library of creative canvas components. Real HTML with WebGL effects running over it. React, Vue, Svelte, vanilla.
why_good: A library of creative canvas/WebGL UI components (real HTML with GPU effects) — fills the gap between plain UI kits and custom shader work.
value: Open-core: free components + a paid pro pack/templates, the shadcn / Tailwind-UI monetization path.
risk: Component libraries are hard to monetize (mostly free), and flashy effects are a narrow use case.

zh.claim: DavidHDev/canvas-ui —— 创意 canvas 组件库:真实 HTML 叠加 WebGL 效果。
zh.why_good: 一个创意 canvas/WebGL UI 组件库(真实 HTML + GPU 效果)——填补 朴素 UI 套件 与 自写 shader 之间的空档。
zh.value: 开源核心:免费组件 + 付费专业包/模板,shadcn/Tailwind-UI 的变现路径。
zh.risk: 组件库很难变现(多为免费),而炫酷效果是个窄用例。
